pokedexEntries.rb: When several of these POKéMON gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.

pokedexEntries.ye: It keeps its tail raised to monitor its surroundings. If you yank its tail, it will try to bite you.

pokedexEntries.go: This intelligent POKéMON roasts hard BERRIES with electricity to make them tender enough to eat.

pokedexEntries.si: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

pokedexEntries.cr: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

pokedexEntries.ru: Whenever PIKACHU comes across something new, it blasts it with a jolt of electricity. If you come across a blackened berry, it’s evidence that this POKéMON mistook the intensity of its charge.

pokedexEntries.sa: This POKéMON has electricity-storing pouches on its cheeks. These appear to become electrically charged during the night while PIKACHU sleeps. It occasionally discharges electricity when it is dozy after waking up.

pokedexEntries.fr: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.

pokedexEntries.lg: When several of these POKéMON gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

pokedexEntries.em: It stores electricity in the electric sacs on its cheeks. When it releases pent-up energy in a burst, the electric power is equal to a lightning bolt.

pokedexEntries.di: It lives in forests with others. It stores electricity in the pouches on its cheeks.

pokedexEntries.prl: If it looses crackling power from the electric pouches on its cheeks, it is being wary.

pokedexEntries.pt: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow PIKACHU that is in a weakened state.

pokedexEntries.hg: This intelligent Pokémon roasts hard berries with electricity to make them tender enough to eat.

pokedexEntries.ss: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

pokedexEntries.bw: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

pokedexEntries.x: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

pokedexEntries.y: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.

pokedexEntries.or: Whenever Pikachu comes across something new, it blasts it with a jolt of electricity. If you come across a blackened berry, it’s evidence that this Pokémon mistook the intensity of its charge.

pokedexEntries.as: This Pokémon has electricity-storing pouches on its cheeks. These appear to become electrically charged during the night while Pikachu sleeps. It occasionally discharges electricity when it is dozy after waking up.

pokedexEntries.su: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

pokedexEntries.mo: It’s in its nature to store electricity. It feels stressed now and then if it’s unable to fully discharge the electricity.

pokedexEntries.us: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

pokedexEntries.um: While sleeping, it generates electricity in the sacs in its cheeks. If it’s not getting enough sleep, it will be able to use only weak electricity.

pokedexEntries.lgpe: This forest-dwelling Pokémon stores electricity in its cheeks, so you’ll feel a tingly shock if you touch it.

pokedexEntries.sw: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

pokedexEntries.sh: When Pikachu meet, they’ll touch their tails together and exchange electricity through them as a form of greeting.

pokedexEntries.bd: It lives in forests with others. It stores electricity in the electric sacs on its cheeks.

pokedexEntries.shp: If it looses crackling power from the electric sacs on its cheeks, it is being wary.

pokedexEntries.la: Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity. This clever forest-dweller roasts tough berries with an electric shock before consuming them.

pokedexEntries.sc: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

pokedexEntries.vi: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

pokedexEntries.za: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. When in a tough spot, this Pokémon discharges electricity.
